paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Number of tasks by language family.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of tasks across various language families. The horizontal axis lists the language families, while the vertical axis represents the number of tasks, labeled as "# tasks," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80. The bars are colored distinctly for each family: IE-Slavic in light blue, IE-Romance in blue, IE-Germanic in green, Uralic in dark green, IE-Baltic in pink, IE-other in red, IE-Indic in orange, Semitic in brown, Turkic in purple, and Basque in dark purple. The bars are not sorted in any specific order. The approximate number of tasks for each family is as follows: IE-Slavic with around 80 tasks, IE-Romance with around 50 tasks, IE-Germanic with around 45 tasks, Uralic with around 25 tasks, IE-Baltic with around 20 tasks, IE-other with around 15 tasks, IE-Indic with around 10 tasks, Semitic with around 8 tasks, Turkic with around 5 tasks, and Basque with around 2 tasks. No bars are visually emphasized.
